svg.text: MV0-C06 J2 positive-stop moving striker adapter
HR-V0-ARM-ARCH-P0.9-STOP-STRENGTH-CANDIDATE / HR-V0-J2-STOP-P0.1 - PRELIMINARY - CANDIDATE GEOMETRY ONLY - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
2.5D 6061-T651 candidate from 9.525 mm nominal plate; finished thickness 9.00–10.00 mm.
Twin rails X=+/-41.0; top Z=37.380699; height tolerance +/-0.025.
All twelve X-Z profile vertices receive R2.0 tangent fillets; shared adapter holes retain P0.6 controls.
Nominal metal-to-metal first contact: J2=117.999985 degrees; target datum 118.000000 degrees.
The STEP controls the rounded profile and 3D face step. The DXF lines are pre-fillet construction geometry only.
Two symmetric rails keep the load path outside the XM540 case; nominal body clearance is separately checked.
The catch reserves a maximum 0.75 mm undeformed bumper envelope. Bumper material, order code, force/stroke, retention and life are SELECTION REQUIRED.
MTR, FAI, received fit, contact marking, tolerance stack, load analysis, stopping tests, guard/cable sweep and qualified review remain required.
No source property is a released allowable. No stop angle is released from nominal CAD alone.
DO NOT QUOTE, FABRICATE, ASSEMBLE, MOVE, OR ENERGIZE FROM THIS DRAWING.
